subject.title: feat: add private AWS workspace service

question: Should Crabbox support this dedicated private AWS workspace service as a maintained deployment mode, and should this exact proof-positive branch be the landing candidate rather than the divergent draft successor?
rationale: The implementation is technically strong, but it adds a substantial user-facing configuration, infrastructure, IAM, security, and operations contract whose permanent support cannot be inferred from tests or contributor discussion alone.

options.title: Sponsor this exact branch
options.body: Accept the supported-service boundary and finish maintainer review on the head that has authenticated exact-head acceptance evidence.

options.title: Consolidate into the successor
options.body: Port every final fix to the draft successor and require equivalent exact-head authenticated acceptance before replacing this PR.

options.title: Decline the supported mode
options.body: Close both branches if the project does not want to own the dedicated AWS service and operations runbook.

recommendation.title: Sponsor this exact branch
recommendation.body: Accept the supported-service boundary and finish maintainer review on the head that has authenticated exact-head acceptance evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history most strongly connects this person to the Node coordinator, AWS broker, provider capability architecture, and recent lifecycle behavior.
